question: In what form does the vital air abide within all living beings?
premises: Vital air is present in beings
It is situated in all living beings
inference: The wind-filled vital air abides within all living beings.
uncertainties: Agreement of saṃsthitam with vāyuḥ is irregular in the transmitted form.
plain_english: As the wind-filled vital air, it is situated in all living beings.
